citability_verdict: Citable with care. IDC's worldwide quarterly releases (4Q25, 1Q26, 2Q26) are free, dated, and give per-vendor revenue and % share for the top 5 brands (Dell, Supermicro, Lenovo, HPE, IEIT/浪潮) plus an aggregated 'ODM Direct' line (53.9% in 2Q26) — but they never split ODM Direct by ODM, so Foxconn/Quanta/Wiwynn shares cannot be cited from IDC. TrendForce free releases give AI-server growth, chip mix, NVL72 rack value and liquid-cooling penetration, but no per-ODM rack-assembly share. Dell'Oro gives vendor RANKINGS only. China: the only IDC-own China figures found are 1H25 accelerated-server (rankings + combined %); per-vendor China shares for 2025-2026 exist only via media/vendor relays and should be shown as 'reported by X citing IDC' with low confidence. Note: IDC can restate prior-year quarters between releases (compare within one release only), and its 4Q25 release text (Supermicro 9.5%) conflicts with its own table (9.3%) — quote the table.
